items.text: All 8 workshop decisions (4 from round-1, 4 from round-2) have been incorporated into the plan. Key updates: (1) Navigation actions will route to dedicated detail pages — ExecutionDetailsPage and PromptTracePage will be created if missing (d1/r2). (2) Activity pulse uses CSS-only ring animation with transient class, no React re-render (d2/r2). (3) Trigger Review confirmed — endpoint exists at POST /execution/{id}/trigger-review, calls git-control-tower via ReviewClient; added to API endpoints table and all relevant plan sections (d3/r2). (4) WS reconnection uses full-replace strategy via setGraphData() (d4/r2).

All 5 readiness dimensions score 3/3. Problem is fully understood with existing infrastructure mapped. Scope is precisely bounded with acceptance_allow/deny defined. Approach is detailed across 4 phases with concrete file targets and code patterns. Testing plan covers unit tests (action registry, node ID parser, WS hook) and integration tests (Inspector rendering). Risks are comprehensive with mitigations for WS instability, service unavailability, git-control-tower downtime, and navigation edge cases.

No remaining gaps identified. The plan is ready for execution. All required API endpoints are confirmed present (including trigger-review). The only work that may extend beyond the plan is creating ExecutionDetailsPage and PromptTracePage if they don't already exist — this is explicitly scoped in Phase 2.

plan_updates: Incorporated round-2 decisions: added trigger-review endpoint to API table and confirmed git-control-tower integration exists; updated navigation actions to use dedicated detail pages with new page creation in Phase 2; specified CSS-only ring pulse implementation; specified full-replace WS reconnection strategy; added 4 new entries to Contract Decisions table; updated Testing Plan with navigation tests; expanded Risks section with git-control-tower and navigation risks.
